steps.action: Create a TeleScreen Hub grain through its normal application action and open it as the grain owner.
steps.expectedResult: The Sandstorm shell opens the grain and the TeleScreen Hub application renders its own visible interface without a blank page, fatal process error, or authorization refusal.

steps.action: Read the initial application surface and stop without configuring a provider, submitting a screening request, or approving any action.
steps.expectedResult: The initial TeleScreen Hub surface remains available. No screening result, external case, release, payment, or blockchain transaction is created by this launch-only probe.

launchProbe.expectedResult: A human can launch TeleScreen Hub through its normal visible UI and reach the application surface; the probe stops before any screening or external mutation.

steps: Delete the temporary TeleScreen Hub grain created for the launch probe.
No screening request or provider configuration is submitted during the probe, so there is no external case or transaction to clean up.
